project.product: portable power banks and charging accessories

export_notes.adaptation: Rewritten evaluation example; identities, dates and commercial values are invented.

messages.body: Hi Kai, I work with VOLTLEAF on portable charging products. Would Road Loom be interested in a YouTube integration? We could discuss a sample to try before agreeing paid work. Timing is flexible. Best, Mira
Hi Mira, I would be interested in trying a product. Portable charging could be useful on our trips. Best, Kai
Thanks, Kai. I will discuss the opportunity with the client and get back to you. Best, Mira
Could you share your rate for one integrated segment and what is included? Best, Mira

My rate is EUR 320 for one integrated segment, up to 100 seconds. It includes a description link, discount code, hashtags and a brand tag, plus a pinned comment. I do not include a product picture in the video cover or the brand name in the video title. Payment is by PayPal and I do not issue an invoice. Best, Kai
Thanks for explaining the package. I will discuss these details with VOLTLEAF. Best, Mira

Hi Kai, the client confirmed EUR 320 for one integration based on the inclusions you described. Could you share shipping details? Would you also be open to featuring the product in more than one video? Best, Mira

Hi Mira, my shipping details are below. [Shipping details omitted from adaptation.] I am away until July 29, so please take that into account when sending the package. I would prefer to start with one video and discuss any further collaborations later. Can you confirm that payment by PayPal without an invoice is okay? Best, Kai

Hi Kai, the client selected the VOLTLEAF Travel Brick T8 power bank. PayPal without an invoice is fine, with payment approximately five business days after publication. We have noted that you return on July 29 and will take that into account for shipping. Best, Mira
That all works for me, thank you. Let's proceed. Please send the tracking details when available. Best, Kai
